people-of-the-book.name: The People of the Book
people-of-the-book.title: The People of the Book
people-of-the-book.dict: Those who were given a scripture before the Quran: Jews and Christians. They are called to "a common word" (3:64); "they are not alike", and some of them are upright (3:113-115). Their food is lawful to the believers, and so is marriage to their chaste women (5:5). They are to be argued with only in the best manner (29:46); and those of them who do not follow the religion of truth are to be fought until they pay the tax (9:29).

people-of-tubba.name: The people of Tubba
people-of-tubba.title: The people of Tubba
people-of-tubba.dict: Named twice among the peoples destroyed for their sins (44:37, 50:14). Tubba was a title of the kings of Yemen.

pharaoh.name: Pharaoh
pharaoh.title: Pharaoh (Firawn)
pharaoh.dict: The tyrant who enslaves the Children of Israel and kills their sons, and the Quran's chief example of pride: "I am your Lord, the most high" (79:24). He rejects Moses' signs, pursues Israel into the sea, and says as he drowns, "I believe"; too late, but his body is preserved as a sign (10:90-92). His wife is an example of faith (66:11).
